## Why it matters

The ZLB digital collections bring together books, maps, newspapers, photographs, and other materials from Berlin's Central and State Library.

For urban and regional history, it offers a focused route into Berlin-related printed and visual sources, although the site currently blocks automated access for detailed inspection.
